# CBDB-Desktop: Networks (Look At Social Networks) label revisions, 2026-10-28

Seventh form in the review of HTML labels against the MS Access FormLabels table (form code LAN, 88 rows in the updated 643-row table, the most of any form). Changes are in the Networks form's index.html only; no back-end change was needed. The page script was syntax-checked, and the page was loaded in a scripted browser (jsdom) with a stand-in server: all 92 labels written by setLanguage were compared with their translations in all three languages, and the dynasty summary, the title, the Navigation link and the place-dependent checkboxes were checked, with no script errors. **Not yet tested in the running app**; spacing and fit are still to be checked. A copy of the file before these changes was kept as index.before-labels.html. Revised later the same day with the user's answers on LAN 64 and 73, the plural tab name, a Link Count column for the relations tab (NET-L1), and "Look At …" in the title.

## How to revert a label

All labels are in the translations object near the top of the script, under english, traditional and simplified. Change the value of the key in the **Key** column, in the language concerned. Each line now has a comment naming its FormLabels row (or "No row") and, where changed, the earlier wording. Where the English changed, the same text is also written in the HTML element; setLanguage('english') overwrites it on load, so editing translations.english is enough.

One change of mechanism: setLanguage used to append an ASCII colon to From and To (t.from + ':'). The colon is now part of the value (From:, 始年：), so the Chinese labels can take the full-width colon. The English on screen is unchanged.

## Notes

**LBL-80.** The title follows the decision of 2026-10-28, "CBDB: " + form name, with the form name from LAN 60 (Looking at Social Networks / 查看社會網絡), changed to "Look At Social Networks" by the user's decision of 2026-10-28 that every form uses "Look At …". The HTML had "CBDB — Looking at Networks / 查看人際網絡" as fixed text in both languages at once. The title span got id="pageTitle", and setLanguage also sets document.title.

**LBL-81.** As on the other forms: id="lnkNavigation", a navigation key, and '← ' + t.navigation in setLanguage. LAN 58 (Exit 退出) not used.

**LBL-82.** 選擇人名 and 輸入人名 replace 選擇人物 and 匯入人物, as on every other form. Recall Person IDs replaces 調取ID, so the button now has the same wording on every form reviewed (CBDB-D-007).

**LBL-83.** Settles the remaining place-filter wording. "Limit Search by Place" becomes LAN 78's "Restrict to Place" (按地方限制查詢), with the HTML's capitalisation. LAN 77 has the singular "Use XY Reference"; the plural is used, as on the other forms. **Check the Place Filter section's width:** Include Subordinate Units is much longer than Include Sub-Units. The three checkboxes were already enabled only after a place is selected, with checkbox + &lt;label for&gt; markup, so no behaviour change was needed (checked in jsdom).

**LBL-84.** The table words these as actions: Include Kin / 包括親屬關係, Include Non-Kin / 包括社會關係, Include Male / 包括男性, Include Female / 包括女性. Before, the Chinese for Male and Female was a single character (男 / 女).

**LBL-85.** The radio buttons take the wording now used on Entry, Association Pairs and Associations (No Dates, Use Index Years, Use Dynasties). 索引年份 becomes 利用指數年. The Select Dynasties button had no id and stayed in English; it now has id="btnSelectDynasty" and a selectDynasties key (選擇朝代, as on Entry). From / To use LAN 5–6 (始年 / 終年), not the 起 / 終 of the HTML.

**LBL-86. Saving to GIS, settled.** LAN 53, 54, 56 and 57 have 保存: UCINet, 保存: Pajek and so on, with a colon. Every other form's rows (and LAN 88 for Neo4j) have 保存于…, so 保存于… was used here too and the open item is closed. Revert to 保存: … in the four keys if the table's wording is preferred. Store Person IDs follows the regional-usage rule. Export Query Results and the KML option had 導出 in traditional, which is the mainland word; they now have 匯出. "Include ID in Output" becomes LAN 65's "Include Person ID" (包括人物代碼).

**LBL-87. Tab names.** The three results tabs take LAN 17, 18 and 64 (17 in the plural, "Social Network Relationships", at the user's request), as Group Data and Kinship took their tables' tab names. **The English is long:** "People Participating in the Social Network" and "Social Network Relationships" will make the tab bar much wider than "People" and "Relations". If they don't fit, the Chinese can stay and the English could be shortened; I'd suggest "Network Relations", "Network People" and "Aggregated Network". The Relation Types tab has no row; 類型 became 類別, the term used for Type on every form.

**LBL-88. Association types.** The 33 categories now use the Access wording, which is the vocabulary of CBDB's association codes (官場平等關係, 薦舉保任, 學術襄助, 書札 …), replacing first-pass translations such as 平等關係, 推薦／贊助 and 書信. Things to know:

- **Heading.** "Association Types (Non-Kinship)" becomes LAN 16's "Select Type of Relations" (選擇社會關係類別). The English no longer says "non-kinship"; 社會關係 does, in CBDB's usage.
- **Select All.** LAN 19 is "Select All" / 所有類別 ("all categories"). The checkbox also deselects, which the old "Select / Deselect All" said; a ticked/unticked checkbox labelled Select All is the usual convention.
- **Military group.** Its "all" checkbox read just "Military" (軍事), the same as the group heading, while the other groups have All Politics, All Scholarship and All Writings. It now reads All Military / 所有軍事. These four "all" labels have no rows.
- **Writings.** The group heading is now 著述 (LAN 43, as the Browser's Writings tab), and All Writings follows (所有著述). The English names change to the table's (Biographical Texts, Commemorative Texts, Epitaphs, Explanatory Texts, Correspondences, Admonitory Texts, Texts for Social Occasions, Prefaces / Postfaces, Ritual Texts). The checkboxes were in alphabetical order of the old English names; they were left in the same order, so they are no longer alphabetical in English. "Correspondences" is the table's wording.
- **Politics.** Equal Relations (plural), Superior Relation and Supportive Association follow the table's English.

**LBL-89.** Node distance takes LAN 7 (Max Node Dist, 距離限制), written out as "Max Node Distance:". Max Loops keeps its English, which is the written-out form of LAN 8 ("Max Loop #"); the Chinese becomes 循環數限制. The section heading 迴圈與距離 (no row) now uses 循環, to match.

**LBL-90.** As on Kinship: 先世值≤ / 後世值≤ / 旁系值≤ / 姻親值≤ with the written-out English, and Use Kinship Parameters as LAN 70 (使用親屬的距離參數). **Check the fit:** the four labels sit in a wrapping row, and the English is much longer than "Max Up:". The labels did not grey out while their boxes were disabled; the new CSS-2 rule in cbdb_styles.css (see the Office report) now greys them.

**`LAN` 64.** For "Aggregated Social Network", c_fanti has 總合多種社會關係 and c_jianti 綜合多種社会关系. 綜合 / 综合 ("combined, synthesized") was used in both, which the user confirmed on 2026-10-28. ## NET-L1: Link Count on the Social Network Relationships tab

**Request.** The Aggregated Social Network tab shows a Link Count, but the Social Network Relationships tab did not. The link count is the number of records one edge stands for, for example the number of letters X wrote to Y, which form one edge rather than one edge per letter. The Access version labels it "Count" in its results table.

**Finding.** No back-end change was needed. NetworkEdgeRecord already has LinkCount (json:"linkCount"), and the edge query in networks_form_backend.go already reads COALESCE(c_link_count,0) from ZZ_SN_NETWORK into it; the Export Query Results CSV already includes it. Only renderEdgesTab left it out.

**Change.** renderEdgesTab has a sortable **Link Count** column after 關係, the same place as on the Aggregate tab, and sorts it numerically. While there, the second "Name" header, for the associate, was renamed **Assoc Name**, as on the Aggregate tab; before, the tab had two columns both headed "Name".

**jsdom check.** Three test edges with link counts 7, 1 and 3: the column shows them, every row has 28 cells to match the 28 headers, and sorting gives 1, 3, 7.

**To check in the app.** That the edge rows have real counts. If every row shows 0, ZZ_SN_NETWORK.c_link_count isn't filled for edges by the copy statements (sqlCopyNonkin / sqlCopyKin in networks_form_query.go, which wasn't part of this review); the Aggregate tab's counts are computed separately.

## Issues

1. **Colons.** Networks now uses full-width colons in Chinese labels (始年：, 數量：), as the conventions document says. Entry's From / To / Code labels still have ASCII colons (始年: etc.); align them on the next pass.
1. **Count.** This form's person count is "Count:" (數量：); Kinship's is "Person count:" (人物數量：). Neither has a row. Make them the same?
1. **Untranslated text.** The placeholders ((name), (名), (ID), (place name), (地名), Year), "[Imported List]" and its fixed Chinese counterpart, the address-picker labels ([All Filtered], [Multi-select]), "No results yet…", the overlay, status and error messages, and the sort tooltips are English only, or fixed in one language.
1. **Results-table headers.** Hard-coded and mixed, as on the other query forms.
